question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence structure suggests a conditional relationship: **having certain qualities will help you reach success.**
 
• The word **"if"** is most suitable, as it sets up the condition under which the outcome (making it to a place called success) occurs.
 
• The other options** (whether, so, and) **do not fit the intended conditional meaning in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Whether" - This option is used to introduce alternatives, but it does not fit the intended conditional structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "So" - This option indicates a result or consequence, but the sentence requires a condition to be set up, not a consequence.
 
• **Option 4:** "And" - This option is a conjunction that simply adds information, but it does not establish the necessary conditional relationship.
